# Security reporting

## Report a vulnerability

Use [GitHub private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/P4suta/law-history/security/advisories/new) for a vulnerability in law-history.
Include the Git commit, affected command or API route, a minimal reproducer, and the observed impact.
Share sensitive reproducer details through the private report rather than a public issue.

Ordinary parsing errors, source corrections, and unsupported legal syntax can use the public issue forms when they contain no sensitive data.

## Maintenance

The project accepts reports for the default branch.
The project doesn't publish packaged releases.
The HTTP server defaults to loopback and doesn't authenticate users.
Describe any external access-control boundary when reporting a deployed instance.

The [assurance scope](../docs/assurance.md) records the checks and their limits.
The [project status](../docs/status.md) distinguishes available features from incomplete source coverage.
